purpose: Rejection record for pairing two output columns in the Q8 four-row path

experiment.description: Pair two output columns in the ordinary narrow-sum Q8 four-row loop. Bit equality is checked only for written paired columns in full four-row blocks. Odd output columns come from the reference, remainder rows are skipped, and the helper has no wide-sum fallback. This is not a complete production replacement.
experiment.reason: Not adopted: no reliable benefit demonstrated. The historical timings below are confounded and do not quantify an isolated kernel regression. Register pressure from 32 partial accumulators is a hypothesis, not a measured explanation.

review_audit.historical_timing_status: Preserved unchanged, but not an equivalent-work benchmark: production may dispatch multiple workers while the helper is serial; production includes wide-sum scan and dispatch; the out33 helper omits the last column. GOMAXPROCS was not recorded. The 2.91x/4.63x values must not be attributed to spilling alone.
review_audit.test_scope: Finite narrow-sum inputs only. Added in=1/63/65 coverage for input/group tails. No claim for odd output tails, remainder rows, wide-sum fallback or Q4.
review_audit.timing_harness: Timing now requires MONOLITH_Q8_COLPAIR4_TIMING, pins GOMAXPROCS=1 and excludes odd output counts. It still compares dispatcher versus range helper with different scan/dispatch overhead; only exploratory timings, not matched kernel evidence. No replacement timing data collected during this audit.
